info.title: Instapaper Universal API
info.description: Save, organize, and read articles with Instapaper

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

archived.description: Optional 1 or 0 value that archives the bookmark while adding it.

content.description: Optional full HTML content used when Instapaper cannot crawl the page itself.

description.description: Optional plaintext description or summary of the article.

folderId.description: Optional destination folder ID from List Folders.

isPrivateFromSource.description: Optional short label that makes the bookmark private and requires content.

resolveFinalUrl.description: Optional 1 or 0 value that tells Instapaper whether to resolve redirects before saving.

tags.description: Optional JSON array of tag objects, for example [{"name":"Tag Name"}].

title.description: Optional title. If omitted, Instapaper tries to detect it.

url.description: The URL to save, unless you are creating a private bookmark.
